summary: Rev 5 (2026-11-19): the approved N1 look at S 0.65 walking on one N10; the N10 lies along Y high in the dome in a closed sleeve (one screw behind), a crown pair turns the drive 90 degrees at the front and two gears bring it down in front of crank 1 into the spine strip, which turns the 4 crankshafts that swing the 8 legs on steel pins; the switch sits under the base (pressed into a floor pocket from inside, closed below by a 0.8 mm skin with a slot for the lever; no cover, no screw). Probe status: does not fit yet, best layout F2s-sw least -1.75 mm with every box placed and the strip gear counted against the arms (-1.64 crown vs shell if that gear is exempt as the strip; probes.py layouts5). Measured again with real shapes on that layout (probes.py real): least -1.74 (strip gear 2 vs arms), 20 pairs still overlap, does not fit.

acceptance.text: It walks on its 8 legs inside the approved look, with every part inside the body (no box left out) and min gap >= 0 over the 24 poses
the approved N1 look at S 0.65: jenscolt body, eyes and base, his legs on N0's path, high knees
one N10 3 V gear motor and 6 x AG13 wired 2S3P (3 V), a switch, no microcontroller
two eye bores for the 5 mm LEDs from the Arduino kit; no eyes board (Morante wires them)
every part fits inside with every box placed: motor, clamp, gears, cell packs, switch, wires
every part prints with <= 10 % support and none on a functional face (Bambu P2S, PLA)
not a scale above S 0.65 to solve a fit (ceiling S 0.70; change placement, toy's own layout first)
every part held in all six directions
the train turns by hand from the motor shaft with every gear in mesh
every screw reachable with the 2.5 mm hex key in assembly order
the gear meshing crank 1 is the 5th strip gear and runs beside crank 1's arm ends with the strip's clearance (coupon K3c, accepted by Morante 2026-11-19)
the switch under the base keeps at least 3 mm of the approved N1 walk's 8.9 mm minimum base height and clear of the legs' sweep

open_questions.q: No layout reaches min gap ≥ 0 at S 0.65 with every box placed (best F2s-sw -1.75: strip gear vs arms; -1.64 crown vs shell, -1.40 crown vs front body boss, -1.32 packs vs LEDs). The switch is already under the base. Which way to go?
options: F2s-sw, and round r00 places the remaining boxes by hand on the N2 shapes (no S change)
drop the body bosses: the body clips onto the base rim (frees the front and rear skirt)
cells as one 2S3P pack across the top of the motor (new search)
open_questions.default: F2s-sw, then a new search with the shell shapes before r00

decisions.decision: switch held by its pocket alone: pressed in from inside (+z), pocket closed below by a 0.8 mm skin with a slot for the lever, glue optional; no cover and no screw (5.5 mm below the base, 3.4 mm of the 8.9 mm ground height left)

switch under the base: body in the floor, lever from below; keeps the ground clearance of the approved N1 walk and clear of the legs' sweep; the inside switch box and its retainer boss leave the interior
motor in a closed sleeve with one screw behind (no clamp ears)
strip rule accepted: the gear meshing crank 1 is a 5th strip gear, proven by coupon K3c
the toy cannot be opened: no teardown data; T1 stays the inferred toy-style candidate
defaults kept: LEDs 5 mm, base rim up, one keeper per side
